name: Treetops at Red Hill
address: 80 McIlroys Rd, Red Hill South VIC 3937
signature: Two quiet self-contained cottages opposite a micro-vineyard — local breakfast provisions included, Port Phillip Estate 0.9km away
editorNote:
Two quiet self-contained couples' cottages at 80 McIlroys Rd, Red Hill South, directly opposite a micro-vineyard. Local breakfast provisions in the fridge on arrival, private entry for each cottage. Port Phillip Estate is 0.9 kilometres away.

This is the hinterland position without the estate-villa price: the wine country is immediately outside the window and on the road, but the format is cottage rather than resort. For the trip built around the Red Hill South winery circuit, this is the most wine-adjacent affordable option in the hinterland set. New entrant, operating status confirmed via website.
whyWeGo: 0.9 kilometres from Port Phillip Estate, local breakfast provisions included — the most wine-country-adjacent value cottage in the Red Hill South cluster.
ifOnlyOneThing: Pair with Port Phillip Estate for dinner one night — the drive is under two minutes.
